what: With Sri's approval, reordered the queue by hand: set three known fixes urgent (misread-field bug, failing batch-ordering test, throughput clock), held three items that loop on the queue (budget-short and always-refused), raised 62 steward and Hestia fix requests to high (website and study content left as they were), and filed three urgent requests: queue out-of-scope follow-ups as requests, rank Athena's own fixes ahead of feature work, and count fixes queued vs run.
why: Sri's reset request (fixes first) was read as one Hestia change; the reading left queue order out of scope and nothing queues its follow-ups. Sri chose a one-time manual unblock.
